Gungans no ever give up to mackaneeks or anyone!|[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''booma''', also known as a '''boomer''' or '''energy ball''', was a weapon used by members of the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Description==
[[File:Booma.png|thumb|left|250px|Out-of-control catapult boomas careen toward the Trade Federation [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] armies.]]
The booma consisted of blue [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] from the depths of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] oceanic core, pressurized and forced into a shell that would burst if thrown hard enough. It was very effective against [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and vehicles because the plasma was electrified, and seemed to have the properties of an EMP weapon. It could also burn biological material and leave a trail of plasma "goo" upon impact.

Boomas were made in many different sizes. Small boomas were used by [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Militiagung/Legends|militiagungs]] and cavalry, thrown either by bare hands or with the use of weapons such as the [[Cesta/Legends|cesta]] or [[Atlatl/Legends|atlatl]]. Larger ones were launched from [[Falumpaset/Legends|falumpaset]]-towed [[Gungan catapult/Legends|catapults]] and launchers attached to the backs of domesticated animals such as the [[Fambaa/Legends|fambaa]] or [[lerraa]].

==History==
[[File:Droidgunganball.jpg|thumb|250px|A booma impacts a B1 battle droid at the Battle of Grassy Plains.]]
Prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Gungans had enjoyed many centuries of peace, and so their weaponry had become more ornamental than practical, though occasionally it was used for security purposes. The Grand Army was sometimes called upon to deter sea creatures from wandering too close to their settlements. During the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Grassy Plains]], booma weaponry was used extensively to combat the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]' clumsy misuse of a booma during that battle inadvertently took down the [[OOM-series battle droid/Legends|pilot]] of an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]], causing the vehicle to crash. He also let loose an entire wagon load of boomas during the Gungan retreat, covering the army in part but also resulting in a large amount of damage to the opposition. In addition, they were also used against General Grievous during the Clone Wars to great success, disabling one of his stolen lightsabers and crippling his cyborg body.

==Behind the scenes==
Boomas first appeared in [[1999]] with the release of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].
